summary.text: At a glance: INVENTURA AS is a private limited company (AS) in Bergen, working in bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning; 127 registered employees and operating revenue NOK 205,223,232 in 2025, up 8% on 2024; website https://www.inventura.no.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 127; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 129; 2026-10-06 auditor registration changed; 2026-09-30 latest of 10 news posts on its website: "Inventura inngår samarbeid med Ignite"; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 131; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 128; +9 more.

What it does: Primary industry: 70.200 Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning. Registered purpose: Bedriftsrådgivning, organisasjonsutvikling, utleie av personell, salg og utvikling av IKT-løsninger. I tillegg kan selskapet foreta investeringer og drive kjøp og salg av eiendom og andre virksomheter.
Business address: Solheimsgaten 15, 5058 BERGEN, Norge (BERGEN municipality).
Size: 127 registered employees; latest filed company accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 205,223,232, annual result NOK 17,749,993.
People: CEO (daglig leder): Trond Slethaug; board chair: Bertrand Francois Mabille; 5 other board members; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
Locations: 4 active sub-units registered (incl. BERGEN, OSLO, STAVANGER, TRONDHEIM).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.
Identity: share capital NOK 600,000 (registered 2008-09-27); formerly registered as FIRSTVENTURA AS (until 2011-10-13), RESOURCE-PARTNER AS (until 2007-06-23).
Website: https://www.inventura.no (as registered, and verified on the site).
Company-owned profiles linked from its website: https://instagram.com/inventurano, https://linkedin.com/company/inventura-as.
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.
Recent registry activity: 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 127; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 129; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 131 (14 events since 2025).

Latest news on its website: 2026-09-30 "Inventura inngår samarbeid med Ignite"; 2026-09-01 "Gratis webinar: Er borettslaget klart for det neste store prosjektet?"; 2026-08-31 "Klima- og miljøhensyn etter lovendringen" (10 dated items since 2025).
